title: Packaged Natural Mineral Water — Specification
qco_name: Packaged Drinking and Mineral Water Mandatory Quality Control Order

clauses.title: Source Origin and Prohibition of Chemical Treatments
clauses.text: Clause 3.1: Packaged Natural Mineral Water must be obtained directly from authorized natural subterranean sources (natural springs, deep artesian wells). Any chemical treatment or modification of natural mineral composition is strictly prohibited; only physical filtration and decantation are allowed.

clauses.title: Microbiological Purity and Trace Heavy Metals
clauses.text: Clause 4.2 & Table 2: Total plate count after 72 hours at 20-22°C shall not exceed 100 CFU/ml. E. coli, Salmonella, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, and Faecal Streptococci shall be zero in 250 ml sample. Arsenic max 0.01 mg/L, Lead max 0.01 mg/L, Barium max 0.7 mg/L.
